fusions.name: Flat-Faced Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a blunt-headed arrow that deals 14 blunt damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rivet Drive
fusions.desc: Drives a heavy arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 blunt damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Plank Line
fusions.desc: Sets a line of planks 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Settling Weight
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
